'''Aterph''' was a [[Devaronian/Legends|Devaronian]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] who visited the [[Farrimmer Cafe]] on the [[Mynock 7 Space Station]]. He claimed to have run away from home due to the endless nagging of his wife, when in reality, he was a hired [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] who had been contracted to cause chaos on the [[Space station/Legends|space station]]. Aterph planted bombs in several businesses, including the Farrimmer Cafe. The bomb was found by the proprietors with help from a group of visiting [[Spacer/Legends|spacers]].<ref name="FC" />
